visualBrief.imagePromptEn: A Victorian-era proof verification chamber. A massive brass mechanical computer with interconnected gears and levers processes a scroll of mathematical formulas. On the left wall, filing cabinets labeled with Greek letters. A single human observer watches through a thick glass window. Steam pipes connect all machines.
